es: El objeto deambula por su zona, le entra hambre y se aburre. Aliméntalo y acarícialo con los botones que salen al acercarte.
en: The object wanders around its area, gets hungry and gets bored. Feed it and pet it with the buttons that appear when you get close.

es: Atraviesa muros y muebles: dale una zona pequeña si lo pones dentro de un cuarto.
en: It walks through walls and furniture: give it a small area if you put it inside a room.

es: Acomoda las piezas con el editor (engrane) y captura cada pose. Con 2 o más, el modelo pasa de una a otra en bucle.
en: Arrange the pieces with the editor (gear) and capture each pose. With 2 or more, the model cycles through them in a loop.

es: Deja las piezas en esta pose para retocarla
en: Loads the pieces into this pose so you can tweak it

es: Reemplaza esta pose con la forma actual
en: Replace this pose with the current shape

es: Se necesitan 2 o más poses para reproducir la animación.
en: You need 2 or more poses to play the animation.

es: El movimiento sustituye el flote natural del personaje; el saludo se conserva.
en: Motion replaces the character's natural float; the wave is kept.

es: Para crear animaciones con poses, construye el cuerpo con piezas 3D en la pestaña Cuerpo.
en: To create pose animations, build the body with 3D pieces in the Body tab.
Nutrition: log meals, macros, water and your weekly plan.
Strength, endurance and flexibility routines with goals.
Track your rest and write your personal anecdote book.
Your sleep as a night sky: schedule, alarm, score and night log.
Your personal journal: memories with photos and daily mood.
Finance: budget with expenses and income (fixed and variable), goals (financial calculators, savings/investing, debt) with simulators, and live markets.
Conversational encyclopedia: AI chats, wiki entries and study sessions.
Archive of movies, series, books and board games.
Plan trips: itinerary, expenses, checklist and wishlist.
Calm: guided meditations, breathing and gratitude journal.
Maintenance of your vehicles and their services.
Learn languages: AI tutor, spaced-repetition vocabulary, level syllabus and exercises.
Your calendar: events and routines by day, week and month.
Lay out race tracks, train rails and roller coasters on the map.
Place soccer, tennis, basketball and baseball courts on the map.
Prepare plots, sow crops, water them and harvest in real time.
Raise hens, pigs, goats, sheep, cows and horses, and grow their food in the same editor.

Your idea journal and brainstorms, ten concept-map formats on a free canvas (mind map, tree, timeline, cycle, pyramid, Venn…) and eight diagrams to decide with (pros and cons, force field, SWOT, Eisenhower, decision tree, tier list, weighted decision matrix and Ishikawa), by hand or with AI.

Computing room: a scientific calculator with your formula book hanging off it (Mathematics, Physics and Chemistry included and editable) and eight modes — a plotter with four types (2D, polar, parametric and 3D surface), binary and hexadecimal, matrices, systems of equations, unit conversion, tip and rule of three; and spreadsheets that export to Excel and PDF.

es: No se pudo cargar el motor de cálculo. Revisa la conexión.
en: The calculation engine could not be loaded. Check your connection.
That does not work with these values

es: Dominar las fórmulas de un tema y aplicarlas
en: Master the formulas of a topic and apply them

es: Se van también sus {n} fórmulas y sus subcarpetas.
en: Its {n} formulas and subfolders go too.

es: La carpeta se va con sus subcarpetas.
en: The folder goes with its subfolders.

es: Todavía no hay fórmulas. Crea una carpeta y escribe la tuya.
en: No formulas yet. Create a folder and write yours.

es: Las subcarpetas sin color propio heredan este.
en: Subfolders without their own colour inherit this one.

es: Nota (cuándo se usa, de dónde salió)
en: Note (when to use it, where it came from)

es: Constante: no se pide, se usa su valor
en: Constant: never asked for, its value is used

es: Ese símbolo es de mathjs; usa otro
en: That symbol belongs to mathjs; pick another

es: El símbolo del resultado no vale
en: That result symbol is not valid

es: Falta cerrar algo o sobra un símbolo.
en: Something is unclosed, or a symbol is out of place.

es: «{simbolos}» se lee como una sola variable. Si querías multiplicar, escribe los asteriscos: m * g * h.
en: “{simbolos}” reads as a single variable. If you meant to multiply, write the asterisks: m * g * h.
